## Summary

This page provides users with an overview of significant <u>content updates</u> in <u>AMBOSS</u> from 2017 through 2025. At this time we are reporting newly published articles, sections that have undergone substantial rework of content, new multimedia/images, and new flowcharts on a monthly basis. Please note that not all changes are reported – smaller changes and updates are too numerous to also include here. The turnover of Qbank progress is currently too high to provide direct links to these updates, but they can be found by using the "Custom Session" after clicking "Create a Session" in the Qbank area.




Our editorial staff is happy to provide you with new content, and we will continue doing our best to optimize <u>AMBOSS</u> for medical professionals around the world! If there's something that you'd still like to see added or improved, feel free to let us know via the feedback function found throughout our content or clicking “Feedback” at the bottom of each section.




See "<u>AMBOSS content updates 2026</u>" for an overview of the latest updates.
